articles.author: UI-Edmundas
articles.description:
Improvements

Added RADIUS over TLS (radsec) support.

Bugfixes

Fixed an issue where Mesh downlinks intermittently went Offline/Isolated when U7-LR was used as the uplink AP.
Fixed an issue where blocked channels could still be selected during Auto Channel Selection.

Additional information
If you encounter any issues with this release, please provide us with some details on your setup and include the below information:

AP model(s)
Previous AP release version
UniFi Network application version
articles.title: UniFi Access Point for U7-LR 8.0.62

articles.author: UI-Edmundas
articles.description:
Overview
This release is promoted to Official/Stable release channel for these models:

U7-Pro-Max, U7-Lite, U7-Outdoor, U7-Pro-Wall, U7-Pro-XG, U7-Pro-XGS, U7-Pro-XG-Wall - December 17, 2025
U7-Pro, U7-Pro-Outdoor, U7-In-Wall, E7, E7-Campus, E7-Audience - December 19, 2025

Improvements

Improved client connectivity in MLO mode.
Improved RADIUS failover mechanism for enhanced reliability.
Improved AP stability.
Added 6 GHz regulatory support for Ukraine.
Added 6 GHz regulatory support for Pakistan.
Updated 6 GHz regulatory compliance for South Korea.

Bugfixes

Fixed an issue where IPTV services did not function correctly when connected through U7-IW switch ports.
Fixed an Ethernet link negotiation issue occurring after device reboot or firmware upgrade on models with 10G ports.
Fixed an issue where Guest Portal clients were unable to obtain a DHCP IP address.
Fixed an issue where devices appears as offline when a large number of blocked clients were configured.
Fixed an issue where connectivity would fail on E7-Audience when MLO was used.
Fixed an issue where E7-Audience would stop broadcasting 6 GHz after configuration changes.

Additional information
INFO: U7-LR model support will be added in upcoming releases.
----
Update your devices by changing the Device Firmware Release Channel in the UniFi Network application to Early Access.

If you wish to go back to the Official release after the upgrade, change the release channel back to Official.

If you encounter any issues with this release, please provide us with some details on your setup and include the below information:

AP model(s)
Previous AP release version
UniFi Network application version
UniFi Console Support File (as private attachment)
